title: Geometry of shrinking the second graph neighborhood
statement: Let c be a compactification of h and H=(a,e,p) a proper/open/proper presentation of h [def-pur-etale-graph-interchange-data]. Given proper a' and open v with a' v=a, put S=(a',v e,p). The map from N_S=(P times_Z C) times_P W to N_H=(P times_Z C) times_P H.U is the pullback lift with coordinates the ambient projection and the supporting projection followed by v. Its square with v is Cartesian, hence it is open. The second graph map for S followed by this map is the second graph map for H; its composite with the ambient open projection equals the smaller ambient projection.

proof.text: The map is the stated pullback lift. Its first and second projections give its two equations. Cancel the right defining pullback square from the outer defining pullback rectangle; this proves its square over v Cartesian and therefore the map open. Compare both coordinates of the two graph maps and use a' v=a.
